scope: All pinned model cards and per-voice sample text references audited as metadata only; no weights or audio fetched. Dataset labels do not independently establish model/audio grants. Source-host downloads and local graph modifications remain separate from redistributing weights.

previewTextSource.declaration: Upstream identifies Wikipedia Rainbow articles as spoken source text; no original per-sample article revision is supplied.
